observed_architecture: Raw logs -> trajectory IR -> invariants -> checker -> LLM judge -> root-cause report
blockers: Static/dynamic invariant generation and checker paths include LLM-dependent evaluation.
Default supported endpoints require Azure OpenAI or Microsoft-internal TRAPI; Copilot CLI is another opaque model substrate.
Using an opaque external judge for C7 would not establish donor-independent Brain ownership of root-cause judgment.
admissible_future_use: Framework/invariant scaffolding may be reused only if the causal decision itself is supplied by a Brain-owned or independently qualified substrate.
